scope: Full-text, supplementary-workbook and repository screening for a public human-plasma nanoparticle-corona source after the frozen R3 analysis.

article.title: High-throughput plasma/serum proteomics by coupling nanoparticle protein corona-based sample preparation and capillary zone electrophoresis-tandem mass spectrometry

source_scope.laboratory_anchor: Authors of the CZE-MS/MS nanoparticle-corona workflow; distinct from the frozen Seer/Broad, Michigan State, OUHSC and Gorshkov R3 source anchors pending author-affiliation reconciliation.
source_scope.biofluid: commercial healthy human plasma for the human experiment; mouse serum is excluded
source_scope.human_design: five nanoparticle conditions; the paper states that triplicate runs of each condition were combined for joint database searching
source_scope.analysis_unit_observed: condition-level protein-identification lists, not sample-level abundance columns
prohibited_interpretations: The mouse-serum workbook cannot be used as a human-plasma source.
Triplicate runs combined for database searching cannot be reconstructed as three quantitative target columns from the supplied human workbook.
A set of identified proteins is not silently converted into an abundance rank or missingness pattern.
The public raw-data accession is not treated as analyzed evidence until a reproducible raw-data processing contract is implemented and frozen.

package_files.role: mouse serum proteinGroups and peptide tables; excluded by species

asset_probe.mapping_policy: Only exact non-empty UniProt accessions occurring in the frozen R3 sequence-feature table were counted; no protein-group collapse, abundance imputation or inferred ranks were added.

decision.rationale: The article and data are publicly licensed and the PRIDE raw accession is valuable, but the supplied human workbook contains condition-level identification lists rather than row-level quantitative abundance. Each of the five supplied human conditions also falls below the predeclared ten-positive-shared-protein threshold against the frozen R3 table, and there are fewer than twelve conditions. Raw-data reprocessing could be a future separate protocol, but it is not silently substituted for an executed target.

claim_boundary: This screen records a legitimate public source and a reproducible reason for non-admission. It does not increase the independent-validation, lockbox, external-reproduction or submission-readiness scores.
